```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tidyverse))

options(pillar.sigfig = 5)
options(scipen = 999)
```

```{r}
#| label: import-data
#| include: false

train <- read.csv(
  file = "train.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  fileEncoding = "latin1"
)
test <- read.csv(
  file = "test.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  fileEncoding = "latin1"
)
submit_example <- read.csv(
  file = "sample_submission.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  fileEncoding = "latin1"
)
```

```{r}
count_missings <- function(x) sum(is.na(x))

train |>
  summarise_all(count_missings)
```

```{r}
train <- train |>
  mutate(Alley = replace_na(data = Alley, replace = "none"))
```

```{r}
count_missings(train$LotFrontage)
```

```{r}
train <- train |>
  mutate(
    LotFrontage = replace_na(data = LotFrontage, median(LotFrontage, na.rm = T))
  )

train$LotFrontage |>
  summary()
```
